title: The Economy Atlas's engine and data
about: The economics domain's C++ compiled with g++ 11 or later (natively or in WSL) into data/cache/engines/economy/, and the data the atlas draws: the OECD's balanced bilateral trade (about 50 MB), Natural Earth's countries, the ECB's exchange rates and the BIS's policy rates, built into two products. A few minutes in all.

steps.title: The engine of value, compiled with g++
The OECD's balanced trade in goods between economies, 2010-2024
Natural Earth's countries, coasts and places
The trade-flows product: flows by year, with a place for each economy
The ECB's monthly exchange rates against the euro
The BIS's central bank policy rates
The currency-spacetime product: currencies held and exchanged, month by month
